name: Hey, Izumi, Watch This!
source:
It is a short visual novel game about two women.

The protagonist, who is a university student, goes for a walk late at night.

Suddenly, an unknown woman points a gun at the protagonist and asks her whether she will follow her or not.

After following her, they decide to live outdoors together for a while, but...

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/5326200]Steam[/url]]
translation:
这是一部围绕两名女性展开的短篇视觉小说。

身为大学生的女主角在深夜出门散步。

突然，一名素不相识的女子拿枪指着女主角，问她愿不愿意跟自己走。

跟上对方之后，两人决定在野外共同生活一段时间，然而……

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/5326200]Steam[/url]]
